records.title: AMO: Operator-level Adaptive Muon Orthogonalization
records.reason: AMO proposes adaptive Muon orthogonalization for parameter optimization. The paper is an optimizer/training contribution, not an LLM inference or serving technique.

records.title: TierCheck: Tiered Checkpointing for Fault Tolerance in Large Language Model Training
records.reason: TierCheck is a tiered checkpointing system for fault tolerance in large-scale LLM training. Full text explicitly scopes checkpoint states and recovery to training; it does not optimize inference/serving.

records.title: TRACE: Trajectory Correction from Cross-layer Evidence for Hallucination Reduction
records.reason: TRACE is a training-free inference-time hallucination correction algorithm, but its primary full text reports substantial added inference cost: extra intermediate-layer output projections and mean 2.27x wall-clock latency versus baseline. It has a possible connection to inference-time decoding/correction lineages, but it is not an efficiency improvement and the measured overhead weakens scope fit.

records.title: JanusPipe: Efficient Pipeline Parallel Training for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
records.reason: JanusPipe optimizes pipeline-parallel training for machine-learning interatomic potentials, including recomputation and pipeline bubbles. It is neither an LLM method nor inference/serving work.
